title: Nuevos mundos
goal: Read about the Columbian Exchange in both directions, from sugarcane's link to the slave trade to a debated theory connecting American demographic collapse and global climate.

items: List crops and animals that crossed the Atlantic in each direction.
Explain why colonists increasingly relied on enslaved labor from Africa.
Explain why indigenous Americans had no immunity to Eurasian diseases.
Describe the debated theory linking demographic collapse and the Little Ice Age.
Use 'debido a que / ya que' and 'por eso / como resultado de' to express cause and consequence.
